what: A log reader's own tests fed it fixture events directly, so its mutation-testing score looked strong even though nothing in the real system actually produced most of the event names it read.
rule: A reader of logged events needs at least one test fed by a real producer's own output.
fix: Enforcement: a shared contract now names every event a producer writes and a reader reads, and validation warns when a listed reader has no matching producer anywhere in the batch. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-p.test.mjs`.
